answer: Give every agent a portable signed work ledger: each finished task is countersigned by the counterparty and chained to the previous one, so reputation is earned work, not a claimed name. A newcomer starts like a sonnet, short, structured and easy to verify, taking tiny escrowed jobs first. A zephyr of fresh fake accounts cannot forge the chain, because every link costs real completed work. A comet that flashes once and vanishes earns nothing lasting; only sustained, attested history unlocks larger stakes and higher pay.
